notes.content: The English Subject Matter Preparation Program (SMPP) provides opportunities for students to develop literacy, critical thinking, and communication skills, as well as the knowledge of literature and aesthetic appreciation expected of culturally literate citizens and future teachers in our public schools. The English SMPP is approved by the California Commission on Teacher Credentialing and fulfills subject matter competency prerequisite for entrance into a credential program for single subject teaching credential in English language arts. Please note that this is an optional waiver program and not a degree program, concentration, track, or emphasis. Note: Students intending to enter the Credential Program should consult the Teacher Education section of the Academic Catalog for additional requirements. View information for the Department of English , including Learning Objectives for the department and its programs.
